title: rorca-integrations
_notes: PRIORITY: GitHub is the ONLY launch blocker. Story grouping: INT-001–005,007 = shared infrastructure, INT-008–017,053 = Linear (post-launch), INT-018–023,026–028 = GitHub (launch blocker), INT-029–038 = Vercel (post-launch), INT-039–048,050–051 = Slack (post-launch). REMOVED: INT-006 (premature toggle), INT-024 (workspace-echolocation.ts already does this), INT-025 (generateActionsYaml() already exists at workspace-github.ts:639), INT-049 (over-engineered automation chains — separate spec), INT-052 (GitHub OAuth already 100% complete at workspace-github.ts:352 + github_connections table). GitHub OAuth, webhooks, commit status checks, auto-PR settings UI, and Actions YAML generation are already built — this spec covers the REMAINING gaps.
_audit: Audited 2026-03-09. Fixed: wrong _notes grouping (was 'INT-001-015 = GitHub' which was false), wrong migration numbers (was 037/038, now 047+), stale path in INT-027 (was scripts/ralph/specs/pending/), dependency on deleted INT-052 removed from INT-018/020/028. Existing infrastructure: vault.ts (AES-256-GCM), webhooks.ts (GitHub receiver), workspace-github.ts (OAuth+webhooks+auto-PR settings+Actions YAML), github-checks.ts (commit status), workspace-echolocation.ts (repo scan). Highest existing migration: 046.

userStories.title: Integration Credentials — Extend Existing Vault for OAuth Tokens
userStories.description: Extend the existing vault infrastructure (backend/src/routes/vault.ts, AES-256-GCM encryption, api_key_vault table) to support OAuth token storage for integrations. The integration_credentials table already exists (migration 038) for GitHub Copilot OAuth — extend it for Linear, Vercel, and Slack OAuth tokens. Do NOT create a new encryption system — reuse vault.ts encrypt/decrypt helpers which derive the key from JWT_SECRET via SHA-256.
acceptanceCriteria: vault.ts encrypt/decrypt helpers reused for all integration OAuth tokens — no new encryption system
integration_credentials table (migration 038, already exists) used for OAuth tokens — verify it supports Linear, Vercel, Slack provider values
API never returns raw tokens — only masked last 4 chars (existing vault pattern)
Credentials rotate: new encrypt+store replaces old without downtime (existing vault pattern)
No new migration needed if integration_credentials schema is sufficient — otherwise migration 047
Decryption only in-memory, never logged or exposed in API responses

userStories.title: Webhook Infrastructure — Generic Provider Router and Dead Letter Queue
userStories.description: Upgrade the existing GitHub-only webhook receiver (backend/src/routes/webhooks.ts) to a generic provider router. Currently POST /api/webhooks/github handles GitHub webhooks with signature verification and async processing. Extend to POST /api/webhooks/:provider with provider-specific signature verification dispatch. Add dead letter queue for failed webhook processing.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/webhooks/:provider routes to provider-specific handlers (github handler already exists)
Provider-specific signature verification dispatched by provider param (GitHub HMAC-SHA256 already implemented in workspace-github.ts:803)
Existing async processing pattern preserved (setImmediate after 200 response)
New webhook_failures table for dead letter queue — failed payloads stored for retry
Retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff (1m, 5m, 15m)
Webhook delivery logged to wal_events (existing pattern) with event_type='webhook_received'
Migration 047_webhook_infrastructure.sql creates webhook_failures table (highest existing migration is 046)

userStories.title: Draft PR Lifecycle — Open at Run Start, Convert at Completion, Close on Rejection
userStories.description: SOTA GitHub-native development workflow: create a Draft PR the moment a pipeline run starts (not when it completes). This gives the team visibility into in-progress work immediately — like Vercel and Linear do. The draft PR title uses '[WIP] {spec title}' prefix, body links back to the Rorca run URL, and is marked as draft via GitHub's `draft: true` PR creation flag. When the run completes with all stories passing, the PR is automatically converted from draft to ready-for-review via PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number} with `draft: false`. When a spec is rejected (via POST /api/specs/:id/reject), any open draft PR for that spec is automatically closed with a comment explaining the rejection. The PR ID is stored in `pipeline_runs.github_pr_number` (add column if missing) for lifecycle tracking. This replaces the current INT-021 behavior of creating a finished PR at completion — INT-021 is superseded by this story.
acceptanceCriteria: When POST /api/pipeline/trigger is called and auto-worktree is true, a Draft PR is created on GitHub for the worktree branch immediately (before any stories run)
Draft PR title: '[WIP] {spec.title}' (e.g., '[WIP] Add OAuth flow')
Draft PR body includes: link to Rorca run URL (http://localhost:3030/runs/{runId}), spec description, list of stories with checkboxes ([ ] US-001: title)
Draft PR created via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls with draft: true
pipeline_runs.github_pr_number column (INT or NULL) stores the PR number for lifecycle tracking
When run status changes to 'completed' (all stories passed), PR converted to ready-for-review via PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pr_number} with { draft: false }
PR body updated at completion: story checkboxes all checked ([x] US-001), summary of changes appended
When POST /api/specs/:id/reject is called and a draft PR exists for that spec, the PR is closed with a comment: 'This spec was rejected in Rorca. PR closed automatically.'
Auto-PR setting (PUT /api/workspaces/:id/github/auto-pr) controls this feature — when disabled, no draft PR is created
Existing runs without worktrees are unaffected (draft PR only for autoWorktree: true runs)
GitHub API errors (rate limit, permission denied) are non-fatal — logged as WAL events but do not fail the run
WAL event 'github_pr_opened' emitted with { prNumber, prUrl, isDraft: true } when draft PR is created
WAL event 'github_pr_ready' emitted when PR converted from draft to ready

userStories.title: Map Rorca Specs to Linear Projects (Not Just Issues)
userStories.description: Linear Projects (not Cycles) are the right abstraction for mapping a Rorca spec. A Project in Linear is a cross-team initiative with a start/end date, status, and its own issue list — exactly what a spec represents. When a Rorca spec is approved, create a Linear Project named after the spec title. Each Rorca story becomes a Linear sub-issue under that project. When a story passes, the sub-issue is marked Done. When all stories pass, the project is marked Completed. This is a higher-fidelity integration than issue-level syncing alone because PMs get progress visibility in Linear's Projects view, not just the issue list. The existing story_linear_map table (INT-053) maps story_id + run_id to linear_issue_id — extend with a spec_to_project_map table that maps spec_id to linear_project_id for project lifecycle management.
acceptanceCriteria: New DB migration: spec_linear_projects table (id, spec_id VARCHAR, workspace_id VARCHAR, linear_project_id VARCHAR, linear_project_url VARCHAR, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ)

When POST /api/specs/:id/approve is called and Linear is connected for the workspace, create a Linear Project via POST /graphql (Linear's GraphQL API) with name=spec.title, description=spec.description, teamId from workspace Linear settings
